title: VoIP Calling: The Advantages Outweigh the Disadvantages
summary: VOIP advantages and disadvantages: Discover the pros and cons of voice over ip to choose the best service for business communication.
body_text: New businesses today have abandoned the public switched telephone network ( PSTN ) in favor of voice over IP (VoIP). With VoIP, software converts analog speech into digital packets that are sent as data over the internet. VoIP telephony has several advantages over the older generation of voice over copper wires. Cost-efficiency : VoIP services are less expensive than traditional phone lines. They’re just network connections, which means long-distance and international calls are no more expensive than calls across the street. While you can use desktop phones for VoIP calls, you don’t have to — that’s another savings. And VoIP services include features like caller ID, call waiting, and voicemail that traditional providers may charge for separately. Some VoIP providers offer features that old-school providers can’t, such as speech transcription. Scalability : It’s easy to add or remove VoIP lines — all it takes is a few clicks on a configuration console. That’s a big benefit for seasonal businesses, whose usage varies over the course of a year, while growing businesses can start small and expand as they grow. Resilience : In the event of a power outage or natural disaster at your primary place of business, you can easily redirect numbers to other locations or mobile devices. Flexibility : People with VoIP lines aren’t tied to a single location or a particular phone. They can take calls wherever they are, and on just about any networked device — laptop, smartphone, or dedicated IP phone. That’s a benefit for everyone in the organization who makes or receives calls. It’s especially useful for businesses with remote workers or multiple locations. Integration : In many cases, businesses can integrate VoIP lines with other business applications to improve workflow and enhance customer experience. Voice quality : Twenty years ago, VoIP calls often had lower voice quality than phone connections. Today’s VoIP services provide voice quality that’s as good as or better than traditional phone lines, provided there’s a good internet connection. That last bullet raises an important point. While VoIP has many advantages, it relies on a company’s internet connection. Businesses looking to implement VoIP need to make sure they have a robust, stable, and speedy connection to get the best performance from their VoIP system. For robust VoIP, choose SIP trunking One of the most popular ways to get VoIP services is via SIP trunking. Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) an international standard for voice communication over data networks. Trunks used to be physical links — copper wire installed by phone companies from their central offices to customer premises. Nowadays the term also refers to virtual lines of communication. With SIP trunking, organizations can make calls over the internet to anyone with a phone number. Thanks to all of the advantages of VoIP communication enumerated above, SIP trunks are replacing physical phone lines virtually everywhere. Why Plivo SIP Trunking stands out Plivo SIP Trunking provides global coverage for outbound and inbound voice calls, working with your current cloud or on-premises communications infrastructure. Whether you’re looking to increase the capacity of your current telecom stack, increase coverage and phone number inventory, or extend your on-premises infrastructure to the cloud, SIP Trunking can get you started. Plivo SIP Trunking provides: Interoperability : SIP Trunking is designed to work seamlessly with any IP-based communications system, including PBX systems, cloud communication platforms, and session border controllers (SBC). This elastic scaling means you don’t have to worry about exceeding any maximum number of concurrent calls, as the system adjusts in real time to your needs. title: Meet Jack Johnson Pannell of Trinity Arch Preparatory School for Boys
summary: The Founder of Trinity Arch Prep, Jack Johnson Pannell, has built a boys’ school from the ground up in Maryland. His school defied the odds and offered..
body_text: Jack is a social impact entrepreneur and has organized and founded several educational opportunities. Prior to his work in education, he had a career in three sectors: business, government, and politics. The Future of Education & KaiPod Catalyst Jack’s first education venture was opening a charter school in Baltimore called “Collegiate School for Boys”. In state achievement tests, Collegiate boys outperformed their peers, with proficiency rates in English and Math doubling those of Black male student peers in the public schools. Baltimore Collegiate was 97% African American. Over 85% of Collegiate boys have finished high school on time and are pursuing higher education and careers of meaning and significance. Jack also has a pending application for a charter school in Philadelphia, Philadelphia Collegiate School for Boys. Jack’s vision for his charter schools is to change the status quo in urban education by opening a charter school focused on better outcomes and life choices for Black and Brown boys. With KaiPod Catalyst, Jack plans to launch a new social and economic enterprise dedicated to building a network of all-male K-8, modest tuition academies based on the microschooling model. Jack’s Mission & Vision for Trinity Arch Preparatory School for Boys The mission of his first microschool that is opening in Paradise Valley, AZ in fall 2023, Trinity Arch Preparatory School for Boys is to help families develop their boys into young men of character based on Christian principles. Through Trinity Arch Prep’s personalized learning model, we promise that each boy will thrive and become empowered to love learning through a flexible hybrid school week that expands beyond the four walls of a classroom. There is no better time than now to focus on the needs of boys with emerging evidence that boys and young men are falling behind academically (when compared on average to girls.) We will strive, working with families, to meet boys where they are and develop them in mind, body, and spirit with dedicated teachers and tutors who understand boys.” Why Jack Joined The KaiPod Catalyst Program Jack joined the Catalyst Cohort with a lot of prior experience in education entrepreneurship and a large network to support his new vision. Recently, we asked Jack about his vision and experience while establishing Trinity Arch Preparatory School for Boys, and here is what he had to say. KaiPod Catalyst: Do you get asked why you’re opening a school for boys and not girls? Jack: Yes, and I respond by saying that I've been engaged in boys' education for over 10 years, and I believe through my experience that typically boys learn differently. They experience the issues I mentioned differently, and on average, they have fallen behind girls academically. So, at our school, we’re meeting boys who they are keeping the pace of our learning lessons quickly and varied. We'll have two recesses every day, particularly for our younger boys who are 10 and 11. I couldn't always do that in other environments, but here, because of our scale, we can do that. KaiPod Catalyst: What do you see as the biggest educational challenges of the day facing the boys enrolling at Trinity Arch Preparatory School for Boys? Jack: We ask all parents, does your son love learning but struggle with school? And, I see answers on two ends of a spectrum there. There’s the child who is not being challenged enough. Then, there are boys who are underperforming. Often, they are slow to become strong readers. If you're not reading effectively in fourth grade or fifth grade, you are not really engaging effectively with any kind of curriculum. And then, there is a third category I think. There are boys who are struggling with neural challenges, like ADHD, and they are just not settling in at a traditional school. It’s like putting a round peg into a square hole. KaiPod Catalyst: How do you address those challenges? Jack: I hope that we as a school can address these issues at a micro level, with a small group of people who take a holistic approach. We provide the challenges that fit the individual student's needs. But, we also care a lot about preparing boys to become good young men. Some people would call it character education, but because we're a Christian school, we put it in the context of the moral and spiritual formation of boys into good men. We’re creating a school where we serve others. We serve our families, our community, the nation, and the world. Through service projects at our school, you feel that you belong to a community of people who care for you and love you and want the very best for you. KaiPod Catalyst: What differs when launching a micro-school versus a more traditional school like a charter? Jack: Well, I've started a charter school, and money, scale, and dealing with an authorizer are at the top of the list. Opening a microschool has given me the freedom to design the school through a different lens. A micro-school offers us an opportunity to truly innovate in education. I think that some students really thrive in a traditional school environment, but I think that most large-scale schools are really focused on the middle group students. High achievers’ and underachievers' needs are often not being met. But, at microschool we can definitely focus on what I call self-paced mastery-based education, where we meet every kid exactly where they are. KaiPod Catalyst: What advice would you give to other entrepreneurs who are considering opening a microschool? Jack: We are in an emerging marketplace in education where parents are empowered to make choices, and because they are, they'll vote with their feet. I actually love that. It keeps you on your toes to produce the absolute best education possible. At a public school, where there’s no tuition, and never any exchange of value, so to speak. Remember that parents are paying for your school, and they come to you only when you are keeping your promises. Learn more about Trinity Arch Preparatory here.

title: Certificação ABVTEX: qual a importância para o setor varejista têxtil?
summary: Na gestão de fornecedores, a certificação ABVTEX ajuda a mitigar vários riscos. Confira quais e a importância deste selo para o setor têxtil
body_text: A certificação ABVTEX é um documento atribuído a empresas do setor têxtil que atesta o comprometimento com critérios, como promoção de trabalho digno, combate à informalidade, responsabilidade social e desenvolvimento da cadeia produtiva . Parte do Programa ABVTEX da Associação Brasileira do Varejo Têxtil, um dos principais objetivos dessa iniciativa é fomentar a construção de um varejo de moda sob pilares de compliance e ambientes sustentáveis. Para quem atua nessa área, lidar com fornecedores e subcontratados detentores do selo ABVTEX é uma forma de mitigar diversos riscos que podem surgir decorrentes dessa parceria. Se este é o seu ramo de atuação, confira agora, neste artigo, o que contempla essa certificação, como as empresas a obtêm, requisitos que devem ser cumpridos e por quais motivos vale a pena considerá-la na sua gestão de fornecedores. O que é a certificação ABVTEX? A certificação ABVTEX é tida como um dos maiores esforços do setor de moda brasileiro, e pode ser definida como um atestado fornecido a negócios do setor têxtil que atendem a uma série de requisitos instituídos pela Associação Brasileira do Varejo Têxtil. Basicamente, é possível dizer também que se trata de um certificado que confirma a seriedade e o compromisso de empresas desse segmento frente a diversos critérios voltados para sustentabilidade, proteção da natureza, qualidade de vida para as pessoas, entre outros relacionados. Para o entendimento sobre a certificação ABVTEX ficar mais claro, vale explicarmos o que contempla e qual o papel da entidade que a emite. A Associação Brasileira do Varejo Têxtil, ABVTEX , fundada em 1999, é composta pelos principais e mais importantes varejistas têxteis nacionais e internacionais, e trabalha em parceria com diversos órgãos governamentais, mercado em geral e indústrias vinculadas. Além de funcionar como uma interlocutora desse setor, a ABVTEX promove o diálogo entre todos os agentes que compõem a cadeia de moda, bem como é amplamente reconhecida por conta de iniciativas voltadas para: compliance ; combate à informalidade; garantia de trabalho digno para os profissionais da área; desenvolvimento e fornecimento responsável de insumos e serviços; estruturação de cadeias produtivas sustentáveis. Todos esses critérios são definidos e acompanhados pelo Programa ABVTEX, emissor da certificação e dos selos correspondentes. Não deixe de ler: “ Certificação de fornecedores: qual a real importância desse documento? ” Como funciona a ABVTEX? A ABVTEX funciona por meio da participação de varejistas de moda participantes de seu programa , o qual foi implementado em 2010 e já conta com seguintes números, segundo dados apresentados no próprio site da entidade: 3.943 empresas aprovadas; 51.979 auditorias realizadas. 436.634 empregos diretos gerados; A adesão ao programa, bem como a busca pela certificação ABVTEX é voluntária. Contudo, ao aderirem a esse sistema, os varejistas participantes assumem o compromisso de monitorar totalmente suas redes de abastecimento. Somado a isso, somente podem comprar produtos ou contratar serviços de empresas fornecedoras devidamente aprovadas em auditorias realizadas sob os parâmetros do regulamento do Programa ABVTEX. O que é preciso para ter o selo da ABVTEX? Para ter o selo da ​​ABVTEX, que é um identificador das empresas certificadas por essa associação, é preciso atender e seguir uma série de critérios, os quais serão mensurados por meio de comitê de auditoria externo. Na prática, significa que é preciso buscar a lista de documentos e diretrizes a serem atendidas junto à Associação Brasileira do Varejo Têxtil e, posteriormente, contratar um organismo auditor credenciado à parte. No que se refere, especificamente, aos requisitos ABVTEX que devem ser cumpridos para obter a certificação, alguns deles são: formalização da companhia : tais como apresentação de CNPJ ativo , impostos em dia e outros pontos relacionados; condições de trabalho oferecidas : com a verificação da existência ou não de uso de mão de obra infantil , trabalho escravo e outros; promoção de saúde e segurança no ambiente de trabalho : a exemplo da oferta de EPIs (equipamentos de proteção individual) e de locais de trabalho saudáveis; validação correta de empresas fornecedoras : pela realização de um processo de homologação de fornecedores e análise de riscos que contemplem as diretrizes do Programa ABVTEX; boas práticas de governança : por meio da verificação da adoção de políticas e medidas internas que garantam a transparência dos processos gerenciais; cuidados com o meio ambiente : com a análise do atendimento a leis e normas ambientais pertinentes ao setor. Por que trabalhar com empresas com selo ABVTEX? Do ponto de vista da realização de uma boa gestão de fornecedores , trabalhar com empresas detentoras de um dos selos da Associação Brasileira do Varejo Têxtil é uma forma de proteger seu negócio de diversas ameaças . Por exemplo, considerando que para obter a certificação ABVTEX é inadmissível utilizar trabalho infantil escravo , você terá a certeza de que sua companhia não será vinculada a esse tipo de crime, pois estará adquirindo insumos ou serviços de um fornecedor devidamente qualificado. As questões voltadas para o atendimento dos pilares ESG seguem o mesmo princípio, visto que o selo ABVTEX só é conferido a companhias que zelam pela construção de uma cadeia de abastecimento sustentável. Esses dois exemplos ressaltam a importância de mensurar riscos relacionados ao descumprimento dos direitos humanos e de boas práticas socioambientais e de governança. Mas considerando uma cadeia de fornecimento robusta, formada por diversos fornecedores, como realizar essas análises e acompanhamento de maneira eficaz? O caminho mais indicado para isso é usar a tecnologia a favor dessa gestão. Como a Linkana ajuda a melhorar a gestão de fornecedores do seu negócio? A Linkana é a primeira fundação de dados de fornecedores compartilhada do Brasil . Nossa base de dados de perfis universais de fornecedores permite que compradores busquem, analisem e homologuem fornecedores em alguns cliques. Com isso, aceleramos radicalmente processos de onboarding, de análise e de monitoramento de fornecedores — graças aos dados dos fornecedores já preenchidos por eles ou por outra empresa —, permitindo o uso de dados e insights compartilhados entre as maiores corporações do nosso país.
